profile_text.body:
Fathom is a San Francisco-based company, founded in 2020, that offers an AI-powered meeting notetaker for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls. The company describes itself as capturing, transcribing, and summarizing calls automatically, with a free tier for individual users and paid features aimed at teams. Those team features include AI-generated action items, a conversational search interface called Ask Fathom, AI Scorecards for real-time coaching and performance tracking, and automatic CRM updates that sync call insights without manual data entry.

On the product side, Fathom is tracked in the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category, with consent and privacy handling noted as part of its feature set. The company also maintains a registered MCP server, ai.fathom.api/mcp, described as giving AI assistants real meeting context so that outputs are grounded in a user's actual work. Fathom is listed as a public company with the ticker FTHM and CIK 0001753162, and it carries a California litigation exposure count of 161, though no specific cases are recorded in the held facts.
